entities.summary: Taboão da Serra is a municipality in the state of São Paulo in Brazil. It is part of the Metropolitan Region of São Paulo. The population is 273,542 in an area of 20.39 km2 (7.87 sq mi). It is the second smallest city by area in the São Paulo Metropolitan Area (RMSP).
